prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2025-11-26, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2025-11-26):
| Current ratio           | 0.97 |
| Retained earnings       | 8,777M |
| Current liabilities     | 21,242M |
| Current assets          | 20,702M |
| Shareholders' equity    | 15,501M |
| Total liabilities       | 44,490M |
| Total assets            | 59,991M |
| EBIT / operating income | 948M |
| Revenue                 | 25,270M |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The company shows modest profitability (EBIT ~3.8% of revenue) but weak liquidity (current ratio 0.97) and relatively high leverage (total liabilities ~75% of assets with substantial absolute liabilities). Given these factors, the credit risk appears to be below investment grade but not severely distressed.

DECISION: BB
